batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b Karanveer Singh

batting.dismissal: c Anureet Singh b MG Johnson

batting.name: M Vijay
batting.dismissal: c UBT Chand b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b SL Malinga

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b J Suchith

batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b SL Malinga

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: run out (J Suchith, R Vinay Kumar)

balls.text: excellent shot from Rayudu to thwart the yorker barrage. Pulls out the reverse dab and has connected it very well. Stood outside his crease, saw the ball all the way onto his bat and bat short third man
inside edge helps Pollard and Mumbai. To only one run though. Sandeep is the man again! Terrific yorkers, angled in on leg stump from around the wicket. No room for Pollard to work with
slower ball this time on leg stump, Pollard looks for the whip over midwicket but is too early on the stroke. Ball hits his pads and wanders into the off side
goes for a lap sweep, Anureet does not budge from his plans of those leg-stump yorkers. Only this time it slips an inch or so down the wrong side.
length ball, and Simmons finally had time to free his arms. Does so gleefully and ends up caught at deep square leg.
another yorker homing in on and around leg stump, can only be nudged towards midwicket
leg-stump low full toss which Pollard clips to long leg and demands a couple. Could have been run out, had Saha collected the throw cleanly. But the throw actually was a bit iffy from Axar
around the wicket, yorker on middle. Sandeep again misfields off his own bowling and gives away a run. Kicks the turf, but it's been a pretty good over
wide of the crease again and lands the yorker, Simmons guides it to third man and sneaks a single. No change in plan, just yorker after yorker after yorker. Excellent from Sandeep
over the wicket to Simmons, goes wide the crease and offers up a full toss in the search of a yorker. Slashed through point, and then beats Vijay on the boundary as well. Poor effort
seeks the yorker, ends up with a low full toss which is just as good. On leg stump to cramp him as well. Whipped to deep midwicket
manages another yorker a shade outside off, Simmons gets an inside edge towards midwicket
terrific yorker on middle and leg. Seemed a slingy action as well behind it. But he does give away a single after misfielding the ball

skewed up in the air and Anureet is comfortably underneath it! It's a quick, full one on middle. Rohit goes for another slog and ends up with a leading edge. But it still flies all the way to deep midwicket. Good, high catch under pressure
good length ball on off stump, swiped away to deep square leg

dropped by Sehwag! It's the quicker one, a bouncer as well. Rohit was on the front foot, but still goes for the hook. Top edge flies to long leg where the fielder comes up, sets himself up under it and misses it horribly
Another slower ball, another wild swing. And the speed gun pops up with the numbers - 143 kph. Can't be, surely
that's gut-wrenching for Johnson! it's the slower ball, slid wide of the batsman to keep him quiet. Rohit slogs, gets the bottom edge and it flies to the third man boundary
fuller delivery outside off, whipped to midwicket. Didn't time it well enough
jumps down the track to swat Anureet off his length. And he does. The ball is pulled back, but Rohit is still able to slam it down the ground
finds the blockhole better and Rohit drills it to cover. Looks disappointed with that result
there's a noise as the ball goes past bat. Ump calls a wide amid the loud appeal. It was bat hitting the turf as Rohit chases after the full and wide one
in the slot and Rohit has slammed it down to long-on. Johnson has some ground to cover to his left, by which time they steal another couple

low full toss on off stump, drummed down the ground to long-off. Rohit races across for the first run, and drags Simmons back for another. Miller was the man with the quick throw, but it isn't quick enough. Direct hit would have had him though, but the time it took for Anureet to bring it around
slower ball, seemed to be the leg cutter, and Rohit's inside edge off a sweep fetches him a boundary. His first of the innings
nails it the first time he tries it. Right at Rohit's toes and he can only bunt it back at the bowler
flatter and quicker outside leg as he saw Simmons making room. Clipped through deep midwicket for a couple. That'll be the second time out
opens up his stance and belts a fuller delivery into the sight-screen. In the slot and banished
punched down the ground, flatter delivery on leg

handsome shot over cover. And he'd nearly split the gap between the sweeper and long-off. Moves outside leg to give himself the room he needed. But the sweeper did not give up. And a good dive saves two runs
flatter to Simmons, who goes back to whip it to the right of long-on
slower through the air and tossed up on off stump, Rohit drives to long-off
slid towards the point region to retain strike

hustles down the pitch again, but Karanveer's fired it in down leg. Simmons looses his bottom hand in an attempt to let the bat flow and somehow make a connection. But he does get some pad on it to save himself from a stumping
saw the batsman running at him and shortened his length. The pitch holds it in a little more and ruins Simmons' timing on his punch
shortish and outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
wants to enjoy a wide as Rohit steps forward and shoulders arms to a tossed up delivery outside off
lots of flight, and width as well, slashed to deep point for a couple
full and off pace again, Simmons is forward a bit too early and adjusts with his hands. Slid to point
hits the yorker, Simmons jams his bat down to try and sneak a single to point forgetting it's Maxwell there. Could have been out had the throw hit
back of a length and slanted on the pads, worked to midwicket
chip over cover. Good length ball on middle and off, and this seems slower as well, lifted over the infield
right up there - a slower ball outside off - Simmons is fooled early but adjusts to slice it to point
138kph, short ball, predictably, Rohit has all the time in the world to swivel pull to deep backward square leg
short again this time and Simmons was waiting for it. Plays it late and cuts it behind point. Sweeper has no chance
saw him advancing and pulled his length back. Defended
a shade short, but Simmons' late cut can't beat short third man
flighted on off stump, gets a little turn as well. Defended

picks out deep square leg! After all the effort he'd put into the stroke - ran down the pitch, swung his bat in the big ol arc - but still can't get enough power behind it. Deep square leg actually had to run in several yards to get under it
slows it up and tosses it up outside off, deft little tuck through midwicket brings Simmons a fifty as well
thumped down the ground! He really does love Kings XI. And apparently the Aussies as well. Eases down the pitch to a tossed up delivery and lifts it all the way into the sight screen
shortish and outside off, hacked to long-on off the inside edge
short and sliding on with the arm, cuts to point. No single there
uses his feet, but can't get to the pitch and has to defend
goes back and blocks a good length ball on the pads
down the track to whip a slider off his pads to deep midwicket
fuller and quicker on middle, pushed back at the bowler
chipped to long-off, flatter delivery on off stump, easily dealt with

shortish and outside off, Parthiv waits on it nicely and slaps it behind point for a couple that takes him to his sixth IPL fifty. It is his fastest, and fourth v Kings XI), and Mumbai also have their hundred
moves outside leg, but Axar follows him. Cramped for room, Simmons drives to long-on
flighted on middle, whipped to deep midwicket
tossed up on middle and leg, clipped to long-on
skids in at him, stays low as well. Struck below the knee roll on the pads as he looks to flick. That stayed quite low. Surprised both batsman and bowler

gets down the pitch, takes the ball on the full and tonks it over the bowler's head. Miller runs to his left from long-on , throws in a big dive, slaps the ball away but it still trickles to the boundary
flighted outside off, thumped to through extra cover. "Two, two, two," Simmons yelled, but he's got four! What an outfield in Mohali! Long off can't catch up
nearly hits the blockhole and Simmons has sliced it to short third man and takes on Sehwag's loopy throw. Good presence of mind, and the ricochet off the stumps at the bowler's end gives him an extra
starts off with a highish full toss, Parthiv slaps through to the right of long-off
misfield but Sandeep at point! Kings XI are being shred in their home ground. This was a short ball outside off, slapped right at the fielder but he isn't good enough
short ball on middle, Parthiv has jumped back and pulls to deep square leg
and then the shorter delivery is slid off the open face. But his late cut doesn't beat Sehwag at short third man
strong footwork gets him to the pitch of the ball, and then his power is enough. Straight drive beats the men in the deep. Good plans
gets down the track and taps a flatter delivery to long-off
loads of loop on this ball, way outside off. Simmons reaches it and hammers it over cover
leg side full toss, whipped away to the square leg boundary!
full and a shade outside off, Simmons chops it to deep point. Johnson's pace is working for the batsman today on an easy paced pitch
full on off stump, Simmons drills it to mid-off
that's an offcutter slanted a bit too wide. Parthiv slaps it to the sweeper
almost a toe-crushes, but Parthiv is able to work it to midwicket
into the crowd again! This is a 140 kph back of a length delivery that Parthiv picks up with and deposits over square leg. Nonchalant!
short, hammered to deep midwicket. He's picked out the man. Poor batting
flighted on middle, Parthiv puts all his strength into a sweep but it still isn't enough to beat Sandeep at the long leg boundary
turned away into the leg side. Kings XI have to adjust their lines better
a shade shortish, holds in the pitch. Parthiv was looking to flash and flash hard. But it doesn't have the pace for a shot like that. Pops up an uppish drive to long-off
seems to be the googly, Parthiv had misread it. Set up for a pull, then switched into a cut. Ends up missing it
tossed up on middle, he premeditated the sweep and manages to get it fine
works a tossed up delivery from outside off into the leg side. Deep midwicket runs around to his left, but can't stop the couple that Mumbai needed to cross fifty
skips down to the pitch of the ball and lifts it past mid-on
we resume our usual dart service, square leg on your guard
grips into the pitch and turns past Simmons' poking bat outside off
pushed wide of midwicket this time

tossed up on the pads, flicked to midwicket and there's a run out chance! Maxwell is the man who had stopped the ball, had ample time to find the target with Parthiv haring down the pitch and being sent back. He slips, he was miles out. But the throw is poor. Keeper has to run to his right a bit, and then underarm a throw of his own. Misses
taps to mid-off and retains the strike! Fullish delivery on off stump, he pushes and runs with the shot
length ball outside off, Parthiv is forward with a blistering cover drive! Possibly the cross-seamer but it doesn't stick in the pitch at all. Just comes onto the bat easily
almost three in three. But Axar stops it with a dive at around square leg. Kings XI have been probing the pads of the batsman and are being hurt every time
flicked this time! Back-to-back boundaries! This time it's the fuller one on middle and Parthiv is forward with a whirl of his wrists
beautifully done! Seems to have been waiting for the short ball, opened the face and helped the ball to the third man fence. Terrific ramp shot
136kph, thuds into the pads before he can play the flick. has to settle for a leg bye to square leg
jumps back and taps a back of a length delivery to mid-on. Didn't time it well, which ends up in his favour as he picks a single
lures him forward and Simmons looks solid with a push to mid-off. Needs to discover the gaps a bit more for those singles
stands up tall behind a shortish delivery and punches down the ground. Parthiv has to dive back into his crease as Sandeep fields the ball and feigns to throw
back of a length and outside off, much better line, defended
they've been very leg-sidish in the powerplay and Simmons profits with his third boundary to fine leg. Anureet set him up by bowling on his knees, he just had to put bat to it
clips the pad and wanders away to long leg. He was going for a flick, but doesn't quite connect
well taken single. Nudges the good length ball to mid-on and sets off immediately. Rather a brisk start from Mumbai. Good signs for them
full on middle, brings out a risky little whip to square leg
threads the gap through cover! Good length ball, but it had the room he wanted. Solid front foot stride and his body weight went into the shot nicely
shortish and outside off, slashes and misses with the ball keeping a hint low
shortish and slanted across, Parthiv stands and looks for a pull over long-on. Beaten by pace, and that's saying something with Sandeep
floats it fuller on off stump and Simmons presents the straight bat to mid-on
struck on the pads, but the line was drifting down leg and it was bouncing as well. Sneak a leg bye in the square leg region
fullish and darting back in at Simmons, who has to adjust late and clip it to midwicket. Bat face turned on impact
takes it from off stump and clips the shortish ball to deep square leg
and when he strays straight, Simmons works those wrists and whips the ball to the long leg boundary. Easily done again. The man in the deep is a bit too square for that line
teasing line a shade outside off, Simmons wants to get his bearings right and decides to leave the ball again
good length and outside off stump, Simmons won't be bothered with it
stays on the back foot and punches to mid-off
lovely line just outside off stump and gets it to veer away as well. Parthiv is happy to leave the ball
good length ball on middle and leg, tucked away to square leg in the deep
sublime timing! He's offered ample width, Sandeep overcorrecting, and Simmons leans on the stroke and picks the gap at cover
more curl in at the batsman, but Simmons has sized it up early and flicks it to long leg. Just a little wayward with the line considering the movement he gets. Neatly done
cut back in at the batsman, off back of a length. Simmons dabs it into the off side in search of a quick single. Not there
yorker on the toes, flicked to deep square leg. Saha scurries for a second run, but he can't beat the incoming throw
slower ball, full toss on leg stump, whipped away over deep square leg. They needed six of those at the start of the over. No point at the moment
follows Mitch running away down leg and lands the ball right at his toes. No room to swing those arms. Inside edge onto pad. No runs possible
fullish delivery on middle, lifted down the ground. Didn't connect properly. Rohit was the man getting across to try and take the catch. But shells it. And it was an easy one too
slower bouncer from around the wicket, Saha leaps outside leg, slugs as hard as he could. No connection
slower ball that follows Johnson moving down leg, flicked to deep square leg
beaten by the slower ball outside off as Saha goes for a sweep. This time Kings XI learn their lesson. No runs attempted

slower ball on middle, Axar is completely fooled. Goes for a swipe and is hit on the body. Saha calls his through for a single, but Malinga rushes forward, grabs the ball, turns around and nails the throw at the other end. Axar is well short

they've gone for a greedy bye off a wide and it seems to be quite close. And Bailey's gone. It was a slower ball that skirted well past Saha's reach outside off. Swings, misses, sees his captain running and has to respond. But Parthiv has hit the stumps to put another nail in the Kings XI coffin

low full toss on his pads, Bailey was looking to maul it over square leg. Can't connect and has to settle for a leg bye. And as he completes the run, he leaps up and flings the bat into the turf in anger
lucky inside edge! Gets the yorker in this time, but Bailey's slog connects just enough to keep them in the game
second low full toss, slugged away to deep square leg
low full toss on leg stump, heaves it away to the long leg boundary. One-bounce four to wake up the Mohali crowd
back of a length on off stump, Saha slices it into the covers. Only five runs off that over. and Mitch ends with 4-0-25-0
normal paced bouncer this time and Saha's slog misses again
slower ball bouncer, wide outside off. Saha goes for a wild hoick and misses
goes short and hands room, Saha swipes it away wide of long-on. Pollard gets across to it
shortish and angled into the body, Bailey skews it away to long-off
slower ball outside off, slashed to deep point
full on middle and leg, Saha heaves it away to deep square leg. Powerful connection, but lands on the bounce to the fielder
hits the yorker on off stump, turns it away into the leg side but only as far as midwicket.
low full toss on leg stump, whipped away to deep square leg and Bailey hustles for a couple
full on middle, Saha works it wide of long-on, but can only get a single

scoops a catch to cover! Moved away to leg to try and give himself some room, managed to shovel the ball up and has hit it quite hard as well. But he's picked out Rohit. The umpires are checking on if the catch was taken cleanly though. Everything is fine and off he goes
very full on off stump, punched down to long-off
another low full toss on leg stump, Miller misses the flick and wears another one on his pads. Time out taken
terrific yorker on middle and strangles Miller. Manages to get the bat down for a whip, but the ball thuds into his own boot. Miller's hurting. Physio comes out, but he's sent back almost immediately
short offcutter, Bailey forehands it down the ground. Didn't time it at all
lands a yorker on leg stump, Miller is loses his balance as he tries a whip. Deflects off his pads to short fine leg
gets down the track and slaps a slower, shortish delivery into the covers
fuller ball outside off, Bailey thumps it through extra cover. Two runs taken, despite the two batsmen doing their best to collide with each other. Bailey has to run around Miller, but still makes it
low full toss on middle, Miller has flicked it wide of long-on
another good yorker on middle, Bailey looks for a big swing over the leg side. All he can do is an inside edge onto his leg
full on off stump, Bailey skews it away to deep backward square with a slog
searing yorker on middle, and Miller who was waiting with his back leg across on the off side, flicks to midwicket
yorker on middle, Bailey whips it to long-on
slower ball outside off, driven down to long-off
backs away from a shortish delivery on off stump, cracked to extra cover. Mild confusion between the batsmen, but Miller is sent back early enough. Ends Bhajji's spell, 4-0-28-1
a little short and Miller thumps it to deep point
Bhajji dives, but he can't get to the down-the-track tap from Bailey. Single to long-on
lovely bowling from Bhajji, tosses it up as Miller advances and clips to deep midwicket
flighted on middle, but Miller lunges forward and outside off to put lbw out of play and then sweeps. His power takes care of the rest. Good shot
down the track, but Bhajji pulls his length back and punches down the ground
shortish, Miller pulls to deep square leg.
fuller delivery, slower as well. Whipped to wide long-on
clipped away to deep square leg
back of a length on off stump, punched to long-off
punched down to long-on
tossed up outside off, Miller goes for a big sweep. it's in the air, deep backward square leg is hurrying after it - Simmons runs up and puts in the big dive forward. The ball spills through it

skips down the ground and connects quite well. Except he has thumped it straight down long-off's throat. Chand was the man down there. Runs to his left and slides to pick up a good low catch. Some confusion over it though. He seems to have controlled the ball well, but then flicks it away towards the boundary a couple of seconds after it fell in his hands. But the umpires are happy with it
pushed through on the pads as he saw Miller advancing. Little ricochet to fine leg
shortish and on middle, Vijay jumps away from the line and slaps it to deep point
huge shout from the keeper, but from bowling around the wicket, lbws aren't happening. Vijay was looking to half-sweep, half-pull it but only gets hit on the pads.
goes back and clips a good length ball to deep square leg
tries to make his own pace by running down the track, but ends up yorking himself. Suchith has come away with a another handy performance: 4-0-33-1
down the track and whips a flatter delivery to midwicket
tucked away through square leg

goes straight! That's his strength, and although he looks at the bottom of the bat, he's still managed enough on it. The long-on fielder was waiting by the edge of the boundary. leaping back to try and get a hand to it. But the ball lobbed him and struck one of the cameras
makes a tossed up delivery into a full toss by using his feet, Miller drills it to long-on
good length ball on middle, whipped to deep midwicket

lots of air, which Vijay likes as he backs away and flays at it. But he can only get the outside half of the bat to connect. Only a single to deep point. His timing's been playing hide and seek with him all innings
down the track and slaps one that goes on with the arm straight to short cover
that's the arm ball from Bhajji, and Miller adjusts on the back foot. Punched to long-on
flighted outside off, eased into the covers
stays around the wicket and tosses the ball up on middle, Vijay steps away and slices it to deep point
flighted outside off, Miller leans forward and tickles it away to deep midwicket
worked away to the left of long-on. They're looking for two, but Pollard's too quick
fired in way down the leg side
moves down leg to try and lift him through the covers. But Suchith has followed him and refuses him the room he wants. Inside edge sneaks away to square leg
backs away to a fuller, flatter delivery. The stumps were under threat, but he manages an inside edge off his intended slice through point
down the track again, nudged to long-on
lobs up a full toss and Miller makes it worse by dancing down the track. Meaty sound off the bat as the ball goes into orbit over midwicket. Mars, look out!
down the track for a whip to long-on
powerfully done! Saw a lot of flight on it, got down on one knee and swept it viciously. Reached the pitch with his front foot and from there on, all that mattered was his strength
backs away, Bhajji follows him. Still manages a cut that evades the dive of Lasith Malinga at short third man. Gets up though and chases after it to pull it back before the boundary
tossed up outside off, Vijay drives into the covers
tucked away off his pads as Bhajji bowls around the wicket to the right-hander
tossed up on off stump, Miller guides it behind point and gets a single off a misfield. Pandya was the sub, and had he taken it, a run out could have come into play
gets some turn straight away, although he hits a shortish length. Miler tries a cut, but misses
thumped down the ground, Suchith gets a hand to it and keeps it to  a single off the ricochet
down the track but Suchith manages to sneak in a slider. Vijay tries to adjust with a flick and is beaten. Only gets an inside edge, off the thigh pad for a single to third man
worked off his toes to long-on
drilled back at the bowler and Suchith does well
loopy delivery on middle and leg, Vijay wants a drive through the off side and gets an inside edge. Single down the ground
gets down the track to work a flighted delivery on leg stump to deep midwicket
opens the face and makes great contact with a shortish ball on off stump, but doesn't place it well enough. Finds point. That will be the time out as well
uses the angle across him to run the back of a length ball to deep third man
shortish on off stump, Miller tries to dab it square on the off side for a quick single. No need says his partner
outside edge wanders away to third man. It was fuller and tempted Vijay into a booming drive through cover. Vinay's subtle changes of pace works against him
gets across onto off stump to tap a good length ball to deep midwicket
good length on and around off stump, Miller defends into the covers
uses the straight face against a tossed up ball on off stump. Long-on gets a little work out
down the track to a flighted ball on leg stump, clipped to deep square leg
goes back on middle and flicks a good length ball through to deep midwcket

caught at short third! The reverse sweep fails him this time!  This was held back, and tossed up. Maxi got down on his knees, twisted his wrists around to swat the ball. Ends up with another top edge that is held quite nicely by Vinay. Ran to his left, dived and got two hands to it
there's the reverse swat. But it's more off a top edge that lobs over slip. Seemed flatter and quicker, didn't get hold of the stroke but went through with it
good length, flatter trajectory, as he sees Vijay advancing. Single to long-off

he's away, and typically it's off making a good ball look bad! It was in the corridor, the kind that Vijay hadn't been able to time earlier in the over, but Maxi manages to step forward and punch it through extra cover
good length ball on middle, tapped down to mid-on for a quick single
beaten by the swing that time. Four dots on the trot from Vinay. Hits the seam and beats Vijay's front-foot waft. Maxi walks down to have a word with his partner
back of a length and outside off, slid off the open face to point
fuller delivery, swinging away a touch as well. Vijay wades into a front-foot push to mid-off
gets forward to a delivery that wasn't quite full. Uppish drive into the covers amounts to nothing
fuller delivery outside off, Vijay leans into a push down the ground. Didn't quite time it as the bat fact turned on impact. Still good enough to demand the fielder to dive at the boundary
sits up for Vijay to smack it through the covers. Gets up on his toes, sizes up the width on offer and creams it. Sublime timing
he is definitely getting some inswing, but he's starting it too straight. Vijay's flick has been sweet all year. Gets forward, whirl of the wrists and away she goes
back of a length on middle, he stays beside the ball and runs it down to third man. Soft hands working well there
fullish, but too straight. Maxi should have picked it up and lifted it over square leg. What happens though is that he is struck on the pads
that time he's a little late on the punch. A shade shortish and pushed across him. Maxi gets in position to punch to mid-off, but ends up with the inside edge
gets back and across to a shortish delivery and blocks it to cover
and he splits that gap! Perhaps with some fortune. Good length ball on and around off stump, Vijay waits for it and opens the face. Risky option, but it pays off
back of a length and outside off, he opens the face and glides the ball to deep third man
short and wide, Maxi's cut goes manifests as an inside edge that skirts past the keeper. Got into the shot too early
sends down the yorker around off stump, defended towards midwicket
leading edge pops up, Pollard gobbles it up at point. Back of a length delivery on middle, perhaps with a little shape away. Flick goes wrong for Sehwag
back of a length on middle, Sehwag is behind it with a tap into the cover field. Good, quick single taken
goes for the fuller one, gets a hint of inswing along with it, but he's spilled it down leg again. Kisses Sehwag's pads and hurries away to the fine leg boundary
jumps up to get on top of the bounce. Both feet are off the ground as he punches a short delivery outside off into the covers
clipped off his thighs behind square leg. No bat involved there
slides down the leg side, although he did get a little inward movement. Should direct it better
waits on a back of a length delivery on off stump and runs it down to third man
shortish and slid across the right-hander, Vijay rides the bounce past a diving point fielder
